name: Heavenly Gate
description: (Tag:summon)Temporarily call forth Heavenly Realm armies, swarms of lower angels or great guardian angels and light spirits, such as Empresses of Light, Thrones, 10 Winged Angels, etc., limited to Legendary familiar power or less. Bound to your will, they need your constant energy to stay and use magic; slain angels restore in the Heavenly Realm and can be resummoned, and more energy lets them exert more power. You can permanently bind one via a long prayer ceremony sacrificing appropriate valuables and energy.
